description: This file generates a student monthly attendance report for an educational ERP system, including attendance data, holidays, and leave applications.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Generates column headers for the attendance report based on number of days in the month.

methods.name: get_students_list
methods.description: Extracts list of student IDs from student objects.

methods.name: get_attendance_list
methods.description: Retrieves and maps attendance data for students over a date range, considering leave applications and holidays.

methods.name: get_students_with_leave_application
methods.description: Fetches leave applications for students within a date range and maps leave dates.

methods.name: daterange
methods.description: Generator for iterating over a range of dates.

methods.name: mark_holidays
methods.description: Marks holiday dates in the attendance map for students.
